preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership through privilege escalation)
Trading must be currently enabled (tradingEnabled == true)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the enableTrading() function. This function has a flawed require statement that only checks if trading is already enabled, but doesn't prevent re-disabling. After calling, trading will be disabled for all non-excluded users, effectively freezing the token.
